name: ArcticBase Workbenches
description: Read-only allowlisted workbench and object metadata: no content, response payloads or custom fields. Titles, filenames and descriptions may themselves be sensitive. Only show them to intended viewers.
template:
<Stack data-gp="arctic" gap={4} p={6} style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", fontFamily: "inherit", background: "transparent", borderRadius: "16px", color: "var(--gp-text, #e5edf7)", minHeight: 0 }}>
  <Group justify="space-between" align="flex-start" wrap="nowrap">
    <Stack gap={3}><Title order={3} size="h4" style={{ fontFamily: "inherit" }}>ArcticBase Workbenches</Title></Stack>
    <Group gap="xs"><Badge variant="light" color="cyan" size="sm">Read only</Badge><RefreshButton aria-label="Refresh ArcticBase" /></Group>
  </Group>
  <Accordion variant="default" keepMounted defaultValue={null}><Accordion.Item value="filter" style={{ border: 0 }}><Accordion.Control p={0} styles={{ label: { padding: "calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0", fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: "calc(13px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))" } }}>Filter{inputs.search ? " · active" : ""}</Accordion.Control><Accordion.Panel styles={{ content: { padding: "calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0" } }}><TextInput bind="search" defaultValue="" aria-label="Filter" placeholder="Search names, tags or descriptions…" size="xs" /></Accordion.Panel></Accordion.Item></Accordion>
  {status.workbenches?.loading ? <Stack><Skeleton height={64} /><Skeleton height={64} /><Skeleton height={64} /></Stack> : status.workbenches?.ok === false || status.workbenches?.error ? <Alert color="red" title="ArcticBase unavailable">The workbench list could not be refreshed. Use Refresh ArcticBase to retry.</Alert> : <Stack gap="xs">
    <Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{(data.workbenches ?? []).filter(w => (w.title + " " + w.slug + " " + (w.description ?? "") + " " + (w.tags ?? []).join(" ")).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())).length} / {(data.workbenches ?? []).length} workbenches</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Updated ↓</Text></Group>
    {(data.workbenches ?? []).filter(w => (w.title + " " + w.slug + " " + (w.description ?? "") + " " + (w.tags ?? []).join(" ")).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())).length === 0 ? <Alert color="cyan" title="No matching workbenches">Try another name or tag, or clear the filter.</Alert> : <ScrollArea.Autosize mah={{base:100,sm:options.listHeight}} type="auto" offsetScrollbars><Box style={{display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, calc(220px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))), 1fr))", gap: "calc(8px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))", alignItems: "start"}}>
      {(data.workbenches ?? []).filter(w => (w.title + " " + w.slug + " " + (w.description ?? "") + " " + (w.tags ?? []).join(" ")).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())).sort((a,b) => (b.updated_at ?? b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.updated_at ?? a.created_at ?? "") || (a.title ?? "").localeCompare(b.title ?? "")).slice(0, options.workbenchLimit).map(w => <Paper data-gp-entry="project" key={w.slug} p="xs" withBorder radius="md" style={{ background: "var(--gp-panel, #111c2b)", borderColor: "var(--gp-line, #243247)" }}>
        <SubFetch requestId="objects" trigger="manual" params={{ slug: w.slug }} loadingLabel="Loading recent artifacts…" errorMessage="Could not load this workbench. Retry to reconnect." triggerAriaLabel={"Show artifacts for " + w.title} triggerContent={<Stack gap={3}>
          <Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" align="flex-start"><Text fw={600} size="sm" c="var(--gp-text, #e5edf7)" style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{w.title}</Text><Text size="sm" c="cyan">↗</Text></Group>
          <Group gap={4}>{(w.tags ?? []).slice(0,2).map(tag => <Badge key={tag} variant="light" color="cyan" size="xs">{tag}</Badge>)}</Group>
        </Stack>}>
          {(objects, meta) => <Stack gap="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" wrap="wrap"><Stack gap={2}><Anchor href={"https://app.example.net/wb/" + w.slug} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" fw={700}>{w.title}</Anchor><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{(objects ?? []).length} artifacts · newest first</Text></Stack><RefreshButton requestId="objects" aria-label="Refresh workbench artifacts" /></Group>
  <Tabs defaultValue="objects" keepMounted={false}>
    <Tabs.List grow><Tabs.Tab value="objects">Objects ({(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && !["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).length})</Tabs.Tab><Tabs.Tab value="files">Files ({(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && ["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).length})</Tabs.Tab></Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Panel value="objects" pt="sm">{(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && !["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).length === 0 ? <Text c="dimmed" size="sm">No objects in this workbench.</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && !["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).sort((a,b) => (b.updated_at ?? b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.updated_at ?? a.created_at ?? "") || (a.title ?? "").localeCompare(b.title ?? "")).slice(0, options.artifactLimit).map(o => <Paper key={o.id} p="xs" radius="md" withBorder><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" align="flex-start"><Stack gap={3} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Anchor href={"https://app.example.net/wb/" + w.slug + "/o/" + o.id} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" size="sm" fw={600} style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{o.title || o.filename || "Untitled"}</Anchor><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{o.filename || o.kind} · {Date.toLocaleString(o.updated_at ?? o.created_at, "en-US")}</Text></Stack><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="cyan">{o.kind}</Badge></Group></Paper>)}</Stack>}</Tabs.Panel>
    <Tabs.Panel value="files" pt="sm">{(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && ["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).length === 0 ? <Text c="dimmed" size="sm">No files in this workbench.</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{(objects ?? []).filter(o => !o.archived && ["file", "image"].includes(o.kind)).sort((a,b) => (b.updated_at ?? b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.updated_at ?? a.created_at ?? "") || (a.title ?? "").localeCompare(b.title ?? "")).slice(0, options.artifactLimit).map(o => <Paper key={o.id} p="xs" radius="md" withBorder><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" align="flex-start"><Stack gap={3} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Anchor href={"https://app.example.net/wb/" + w.slug + "/o/" + o.id} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" size="sm" fw={600} style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{o.title || o.filename || "Untitled"}</Anchor><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{o.filename || o.kind} · {Date.toLocaleString(o.updated_at ?? o.created_at, "en-US")}</Text></Stack><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="cyan">{o.kind}</Badge></Group></Paper>)}</Stack>}</Tabs.Panel>
  </Tabs>
</Stack>}
        </SubFetch>
      </Paper>)}
    </Box></ScrollArea.Autosize>}
  </Stack>}
  <Group justify="space-between" gap="xs"><Anchor href="https://app.example.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" size="xs" c="cyan">Open ArcticBase ↗</Anchor></Group>
</Stack>
